title: Seminar; Literary History of the French-Speaking Caribbean
description: Focus is placed on 20th-21st century Caribbean literature. Students will study the socio-political, cultural and psychological themes prevalent in literature in French by authors from Guadeloupe, Haiti, and Martinique. Particular attention will be paid to how these writers have used the events of their eras to conceptualize and build a history of Caribbean literature that has sustained an enriching dialogue among the islands of the West Indies, France, and the Caribbean diaspora. Taught in French.
